selection_reconciliation: Identical original fillings in identical order at both primes; every selected column independently pairs at both.
convention: C=Gram_M^-1 A; circuit columns = recursive columns C; E_common=C_common^(-t) E_circuit. H is averaged; house factor is (4!)^13; column wedges and Pieri strip sums unnormalized.
common_source_definition: At every node, integer-lift P1 U entries to [0,P1), use recursively common children, and apply the rational H_d average. Native P1 is the P1 reduction.
